notes.text: The sheet is handwritten, with no title or date observed. The light pencil 28 at the lower left is retained only as archive numbering. No independent manuscript page number, drawing or arrow diagram appears.

The opening contains the written phrase bien parallèles and the qualification « à cela près qu'il faut exiger ». A deleted attempt is followed by condition (**), continued in the left margin. The independent slanted note refers to distinct a,b and distinct decomposition symbols. The final non parallèles prompted an ink check of bien; it did not cause emendation.

The construction paragraph introduces an arbre topologique, its pair (underlined Gamma,S), and the label esp. top. It describes choosing a point on each edge and records the barycentric-subdivision pair, including the underbrace named S*. The three visible star positions were compared as handwriting; the retraced Gamma superscript remains uncertain.

The bracketed NB records degree 2 for the added vertices and the endpoint wording « une exactement des deux extrémités appartient à A', l'autre à S ». Its phrase « voici une description complète » is retained. The X-star after arête de has a possible older underlined-Gamma layer. The construction context drew attention to both this letter and the relation sign after A'; neither was repaired from expected notation.

The last paragraph describes a cut at a', two connected components and their closures, a binary decomposition and an equator {a'}, ending with an abbreviated strictement and non parallèles. Cancellation of the noun s, insertion of a', removal of the verbal ending and the high Gamma mark were inspected separately. The article was not forced to agree with those changes.

The extra high marks before équateur are retained as an opening double quote pair with no supplied closing pair. No author question mark, explicit proof-check note or dated computation was observed. This run performed visual reading and notation comparison only, with no proof or computation check.

workflow_feedback.reading_completed: Whole viewed once, each supplied half viewed once, all words, formulas, marginal additions and cancellations inspected. No diagram or drawing was observed. No OCR, external research, other-page or other-reader access, or compilation was performed.
workflow_feedback.crop_method: Fifteen distinct crops from the original whole-image coordinates. Every crop was autocontrasted, resized to 3000 pixels wide with LANCZOS, and sharpened. The two slanted marginal crops were rotated clockwise 45 and 16 degrees respectively, then trimmed within the same crop operation. No crop was repeated.
workflow_feedback.edge_notes: Crop 04 meets the tip of the annotation t at its upper edge; the complete annotation was already visible in half a. Crop 07 clips the lower tip of the underbrace label S at its bottom edge; S* was fully read in half a, and the target Gamma superscript is wholly inside the crop. Crop 02 meets the bottom tip of the long f descender; the word body and crossing line are intact and the full descender was visible in half a. These were not recropped.
workflow_feedback.proof_checks: No proof, re-proof, formal certificate or computation check was performed; check_events is empty.
workflow_feedback.uncertainty_policy: Resolved C primary readings are labelled resolved without being counted as C errors. Changed primary readings that remain uncertain are explicitly labelled retained. Agreement of C and H was not treated as ink evidence.
